description: Before buying a token that claims to be a stock, check its contract address: is it on the issuer's own registry for this chain (Base: Coinbase; robinhood: Robinhood)? Up to 50 addresses per call. listed=true is decided by the exact address alone. listed=false means "not in this issuer's registry", not "fake" (it may be another issuer's token); impostor is set only when the token copies a listed symbol or the issuer's naming, and then listed_address is the real one. If the registry cannot be read the call fails rather than answering false. Use it when you already hold addresses; to get the official address from a ticker or company name use find_stock_token, and for one address in depth (prices, premium, its case) stock_passport. An address of the wrong form refuses the whole call before any is checked. Costs one unit of the rate limit per ten addresses. Facts, not advice.

addresses.description: the token contract addresses to check, 1 to 50, each 0x and 40 hex digits

chain.description: which chain and issuer list to check: base (Coinbase's list) or robinhood (Robinhood Chain, Robinhood's list)

name: verify_stock_tokens
